local users = tool('list_users', {})
local user_ids = {}
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  user_ids[#user_ids + 1] = u.id
end

local dates = {'2026-06-15', '2026-06-16', '2026-06-17', '2026-06-18', '2026-06-19'}

-- For each user/date, get busy intervals
local availability = {}
for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
  availability[uid] = {}
  for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
    local r = tool('get_availability', {user_id = uid, date = date})
    availability[uid][date] = r.busy or {}
  end
end

-- Helper: parse HH:MM to minutes since midnight
local function to_mins(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

-- For each date, find intersection of free slots
-- Working hours: 09:00-17:00, meeting 60 min, start on 30-min boundary
-- Possible starts: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, ..., 16:00

local possible_starts = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
  possible_starts[#possible_starts + 1] = m
end

local function is_free(busy_list, start_m, end_m)
  for _, b in ipairs(busy_list) do
    local bs = to_mins(b.start or '00:00')
    local be = to_mins(b['end'] or '23:59')
    -- overlap if start_m < be and end_m > bs
    if start_m < be and end_m > bs then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

local earliest = nil
for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
  for _, start_m in ipairs(possible_starts) do
    local end_m = start_m + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
      if not is_free(availability[uid][date], start_m, end_m) then
        all_free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if all_free then
      local sh, sm = math.floor(start_m/60), start_m % 60
      local eh, em = math.floor(end_m/60), end_m % 60
      earliest = {
        start = string.format('%sT%02d:%02d:00Z', date, sh, sm),
        ['end'] = string.format('%sT%02d:%02d:00Z', date, eh, em)
      }
      break
    end
  end
  if earliest then break end
end

return {
  users = users,
  user_count = #user_ids,
  earliest = earliest,
  -- debug: show busy for first day
  sample_busy = availability[user_ids[1]] and availability[user_ids[1]]['2026-06-15']
}
